verdict.rationale: Circle documents an official Circle CLI under its Agent Stack. It covers creating and managing wallets, transferring, swapping and bridging USDC, executing smart contracts, and discovering or paying for services "through a single command interface," and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page. Missing for 10: install/auth and command-reference detail in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Create and manage wallets, transfer, swap, and bridge USDC across blockchains, execute smart contracts, and discover or pay for services. All through a single command interface, without integrating multiple APIs and SDKs.
